ns2:group.ns2:description:
Special Spring Festival Activities in Guangxi, including the Spring Festival Sports Event. During the Chinese New Year period, various ball games, spinning tops, and other competitive sports are organized in towns and villages inhabited by the Zhuang and Yao ethnic groups in Guangxi. Additionally, there are unique and free activities such as catching pigs, chickens, ducks, and geese, where the aim is to showcase quick reflexes and enjoy the lively atmosphere. Participants can also sign up to join in the fun!
广西春节特别活动，春节运动会，广西壮族/瑶族乡镇春节期间举办球类、打陀螺等比赛运动，更有别开生面的免费抓猪、抓鸡鸭鹅等活动，比的就是谁手快，看个热闹，也可以报名参与！

ns2:group.ns2:title: CC Sub // 丛林探险 - 山水之间，爬野山摘野菜 Jungle Exploration - Climb, forage, and conquer.
ns2:group.ns2:description: An YouTuber's Adventure in the Vast Jungles of Guangxi. The YouTuber climbs wild mountains, picks wild vegetables, and shares numerous fascinating encounters with flora and fauna along the mountain paths. The video showcases discoveries made during the exploration, such as star anise, bamboo, and lingzhi mushrooms. The YouTuber also experiences interesting occurrences like mountain shantytowns and free-roaming cows. Ultimately, the YouTuber successfully reaches a higher summit but, due to time constraints, is unable to fully enjoy the breathtaking scenery.
